title: lsptools
description: The models of mise run lsp: the server registry, and each action's JSON result.

Action.description: What mise run lsp does: change (add, update, remove), report, probe (health, smoke) or check it all.

Source.description: How mise installs the server: a global [tools] entry, or a [bootstrap.packages] formula.

Server.description: One language server Claude Code runs through a plugin, and the mise install that provides it.

name.description: The server's key in the plugin's lspServers or .lsp.json.

package.description: The mise tool (npm:typescript), or the bootstrap package as manager:name (brew:llvm).

plugin.description: The Claude Code plugin that starts the server, as name@marketplace.

fixture.description: The folder under lsptools/fixtures that smoke opens.

Probe.description: Where smoke asks: the symbol's file, its 0-based line and character, and a file that uses it.

symbol.description: The symbol's name, which documentSymbol must list.

PluginServer.description: A server as a plugin declares it (.lsp.json or lspServers); the other keys are Claude Code's.

Registry.description: Every server mise run lsp manages (lsptools/servers.json).

Check.description: One named check of a server and what it found.

Report.description: An action's result for one server: ok when every check passed.

Reports.description: doctor and conflicts: one report per server, ok when all are.

Failure.description: One error event: mise run lsp could not run the action.
